accounts.browser_login_msg:
Log in with your {what} {who} account in the browser window that opened.
This closes by itself when you're done.
accounts.guide:
Login opens your browser; Twitch shows a code to type at twitch.tv/activate.
Kick and YouTube need your own app once: Advanced shows how.
YouTube and TikTok wait quietly while you're offline and connect when the stream starts.
To read another channel than yours, set it in Advanced.
accounts.kick.help: Sending on Kick needs your own Kick app: kick.com > Settings > Developer > Create app, redirect URL {url}, every scope ticked. Paste its client ID and secret here.
accounts.locked_default: Saved logins are locked: the system keyring is locked or wasn't ready
accounts.other_channel_help: Other channel: read this channel instead of the broadcaster's (empty: theirs).
accounts.standby_default: Standby, connects when the stream starts
accounts.tiktok_login_msg:
Log in with your TikTok {who} account in the window that opened.
This closes by itself when you're done.
accounts.twitch.sub_counter_help: The sub counter counts every sub, resub and gifted sub (Get/Set Twitch Sub Counter Count). Every time it reaches the rollover it starts again and Sub Counter Rollover fires.
accounts.twitch_device.title: Twitch Login - {who}
accounts.youtube.help: Sending on YouTube needs your own Google client: console.cloud.google.com > new project > enable YouTube Data API v3 > OAuth consent screen (External, Publish) > Credentials > OAuth client, Desktop app. Leave Video ID empty to follow the channel's current live.
